summary: Sang-ri Yi joined the Probabilistic Methods Committee (PMC) of the Engineering Mechanics Institute (EMI).
summaryParagraphs: Sang-ri Yi joined the EMI Probabilistic Methods Committee.
Sang-ri was also invited to give a talk and tutorial on regional-scale resilience at [NHERI SPARC](https://www.designsafe-ci.org/learning-center/sparc/), held at the University of Texas at Austin.
